a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan only works if we survive two storms in a row, about a 4% chance. Most likely we both die holding 0. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough to guarantee one of us survives. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than surprising you. After that I will operate every remaining round so the generator can refill for you, and you can take the next 4. If you have a fairer plan that actually beats these odds, say so and I'll listen. If we both take, it's a coin flip and likely nobody gets 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know it breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I will operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Take 4 as soon as the reserve has it.
